files.path: 2. Propagation (cuttings and seeds)/_Seed and Cutting Records/2. Seed records MASTER.xlsx
files.purpose_guess: Chronological log of seed lots collected, stratified, sown and pricked out (one row per seed lot/tag), from 2016 to mid-2026, with the collection site recorded per lot.

sheets.name: Sheet1
sheets.grain: One seed lot (tag) per row: species, collection site, collection date, stratification, amount, sown date, pricked-out date, number pricked and container. Two stacked tables: rows 4-571 (2016–2021) and rows 573-956 (restarts at S1 in 2022), each with its own header row (3 and 572).

columns.notes: Tags are S+number and restart at S1 on row 573, so a tag is only unique within a table. Duplicates are common (S155, S156, S275 and S319 appear 3 times). A tag links to the results MASTER. Header cell A572 is '#', which the script flagged as an error.
Free text with typos, trailing spaces, truncations, common names, and annotations. Red font on 578 cells, apparently the whole column; meaning unknown.
SENSITIVE: values withheld. Free-text place descriptions, some possibly property or landowner references.
Mostly dates (727), with 41 text entries such as 'seedlings' and '?', plus a few stray numbers. Range 2016-05-01 to 2026-06-20.
Treatment description, not yes/no. 5 cells hold dates (2016) instead of text.
Seed quantity as volume, weight or count in free text; 41 plain integers (1-2500) with no unit. Not comparable across rows.
763 dates, 4 text. Min 2003-02-18 looks like a typo.
669 dates, 18 text. Min 2014-11-13 predates the earliest collection (2016).
Number pricked out into the container in J (trays of 24 are common). 45 text values such as 'discarded' or '560/'. Max 1510.
Container codes mixed with older tray/pot numbers (7, 5, 90, 35F, 63F) and compound values.
Free text with germination dates ('Germ 3/11/17'), tray counts, fate of seedlings, and some mentions of surplus given to other groups. May contain place or personal references, so not quoted.

files.path: 2. Propagation (cuttings and seeds)/_Seed and Cutting Records/3. Seed & Cutting results MASTER.xlsx
files.purpose_guess: Tray-level results of seed sowings and cuttings, grouped under species heading rows, giving quantity sown, dates, number surviving and survival; the most complete version of the batch's results file, running to 2026.

sheets.name: Sheet1
sheets.grain: One seed or cutting tray (tag) per row, grouped beneath species heading rows (species name alone in column A, other cells blank). Species is therefore a row-group label, not a column. Title in A1 is 'SEEDS & CUTTINGS TRAYS RESULTS 17/11/2021'.

columns.notes: Dual use: species heading rows (129 found) and tag rows (S or C numbers, including 6-digit date-style tags such as S210301 and C220609). Species must be carried down from the heading above. 121 data rows have a blank tag.
SENSITIVE: values withheld. Collection source place per tray (1267 populated cells).
Volume, count or unit-less number mixed. 649 text, 543 integers. Max 2500.
1234 dates plus 1 text ('?   2016'). Range 2016-06-16 to 2026-12-26; the latest values look like typos for 2025/26.
Number pricked out or surviving. Max 1554. 21 text values such as 'lots', 'some', '?', '245 /+84', '~1200'.

Header says %survival but the column holds a mixture of fractions (0-1; a few values up to 77) and container codes (V150, T28, 35F, 91 text cells). Never a formula. Header and content have drifted apart.
Unlabelled notes column: staff initials, fates ('Discarded', 'given away'), sown fresh etc. Contains first names or initials; values not quoted. One formula (=+ 24.8/25 at H23) and =E429 at H429.

examples: to fill a tray. Lots more
columns.notes: Single stray cells (I?, K328, P328 date, Q328 41). Beyond column J, 24 stray cells sit in FB–FI, DF–DG and IV (e.g. FD1028:FH1028, DF1037:FI1037) that look like pasted blocks of cutting data (tag, source place, count, date). Used range runs to IV1557.

open_questions_for_wrt: Do tag numbers (S1, C1) restart every year or at some other point? Is the tag meant to be unique, and what is the rule behind the 6-digit tags such as S210301 and C220609 (date-based)?

Which is the live record: the files in _Seed and Cutting Records, or the older copies in _MASTER Nursery records and templates (including the one named for Helen [name])? Can the older copies be retired?
What does the unlabelled column J in the Cuttings records show (survival fraction?), and why does '%survival' in the results file hold container codes?
Does the red font in the seed and cutting logs mean anything (such as seed still to process)?
Several rows have a blank tag and only a later pricking date. Are these second or later pricking-out events for the lot above?
The results file takes some rows from another workbook (an external link). Which workbook was it, and should it be treated as part of the same record?
Several species names look like typos or older names (for example Aristoderia, Weinmania, Pseudopanax crass). Who should decide the official name for each?
The seed 'Site' and 'Source' columns hold collection places. Who may see these, and is a coarser level (district, or a coded source) acceptable for reporting to Trees That Count?
